description: While the service is disabled in the dashboard, a request to /mcp is answered 503 {"error":"service disabled"} without calling the handler. MCPWARP.md §4 status table
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 28

{"error":"service disabled"}
notes: After enable and a successful re-register the same request reaches the handler again.
